core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Husein corresponds to the Arabic form حسين (Arabic root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n); حُسَيْن (Ḥusayn)). Its core sense is husayn; diminutive of hasan. Husein is a variant transliteration of Arabic حُسَيْن (Ḥusayn), the diminutive of حَسَن (Ḥasan). The source gloss 'Graceful, Generous' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as husain, husayn, hussain and hussein.

urdu.name: حسین
urdu.long_meaning: Husein (حسین) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم حسین، حسن کی تصغیر ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

arabic.name: حسين

faq.q: What is the origin of Husein?
faq.a: Husein is associated with Arabic. Husein is a variant transliteration of Arabic حُسَيْن (Ḥusayn), the diminutive of حَسَن (Ḥasan). The source gloss 'Graceful, Generous' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as husain, husayn, hussain and hussein.

faq.a: In Urdu, Husein is rendered حسین and carries the sense حسین، حسن کی تصغیر.

faq.q: What does Husein mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Husein is rendered حسین and carries the sense حسین، تصغیر حسن.
A romanized syllable approximation is hu-sein. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Husein?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Husein, husein. Script forms are حسين, حسین, हुसैन.

faq.q: Is Husein a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
